test_FSDP_pre_backward_hook: test FSDP with a model that triggers a pre_backward hook bug using nested FSDP and Linear layers
run_FSDP_gradient_check: run the FSDP pre backward hook test to verify gradient shapes and values across forward and backward passes
test_FSDP_nested_model: test a nested FSDP model with flatten_parameters=False to validate gradient computation through multiple linear layers
run_dist_init_teardown: run distributed initialization and teardown for the FSDP pre backward hook test using temp files
test_FSDP_backward_pass: test multiple backward passes on an FSDP wrapped model to confirm gradients are computed and cleared correctly
